section.46: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

46.name_native: The Book of Cutting off the Hand of the Thief

hadiths.text: It was narrated that Ayman said:"The (hand of) a thief is to be cut off for the price of a shield, and the price of a shield during the time of the Messenger of Allah was a Dinar, or ten Dirhams." (Daif)
